local_patches.description: Write merged JSON dictionaries; reject invalid saves before replacing live state and respect custom save paths.
Release interceptor processors without reference cycles; finish and cancel async actions safely; clear scene work, weakly defer map layout and remove self-typed menu dictionary retention.

Content profile switch: Global.get_content_profile() (--content-profile=test|pack user arg, else project setting game/content_profile, default test) skips GlobalTestDataGenerator in pack profile; NewRunMenu tolerates an empty standard difficulty modifier list.

Combat framework Phase 0 (wf/specs/combat-framework): BaseCombatant unit identity fields and _on_own_action_* hooks, UnitRegistry autoload (Global.get_player/get_alive_enemies delegate), CombatRulesData schema + combat_rules_default with original-behavior defaults (draw/energy read it), unit/timeline/party signal declarations, hero unit_action_started/ended in the legacy turn flow.

Combat framework Phase 1 (wf/specs/combat-framework): CombatDirector + CombatTimeline action timeline (CTB) replaces Combat.gd's turn alternation; BaseUnitController/PlayerInputController/EnemyIntentController; CombatEndTurn renamed CombatEndAction; enemies decide intent on entering the timeline; rules reset_block_on_action_start/discard_hand_on_action_end/hand_limit consumed; enemy_speed/character_speed/card_action_delay/enemy_intent_action_delay fields; StatusEffectData UNIT_ACTION_START/END + EVERY_N_TICKS; StatsHandler turn_count = hero actions, combat_tick; TimelineBar HUD; Root.tscn director/timeline nodes and animation tracks.

Combat framework Phase 2 (wf/specs/combat-framework): BoardData/BoardTargeting/IntentResolver/ThreatPreview, EncounterData + EncounterWaveData with legacy-event synthesis, CombatDirector board setup / wave-0 spawning / movement / enemy intent movement, board card/intent/unit fields, ActionMoveUnit/ActionDisplaceUnit/ActionGrantMovePoints/ActionComputeBoardValue, board validators, InterceptorRooted, Hand cell targeting and BoardView, ThreatPreview-based incoming damage, Board suite.

Combat framework Phase 3 (wf/specs/combat-framework): CombatDirector split into BoardController / UnitSpawner / CombatActionPhases / CombatStartActions (intent execution in EnemyIntentController); WaveController wave flow (wave_started/wave_cleared, wave_on_*_actions, next-wave scheduling, victory on last wave cleared replacing Combat.gd's minion check); UnitSpawner pending entries with enter delay / stagger / spawn delay and NEAREST_EMPTY / WAIT_UNTIL_FREE / FAIL_SKIP; Global.are_remaining_enemies delegates to CombatDirector.has_remaining_opponents; CombatTimeline.peek_next_tick; BoardData footprint helpers; TimelineBar WaveLabel.
Load only case-insensitive .json data files from declared mod folders; ignore placeholders, notes and backups while preserving directory enumeration and JSON error behavior.

Restore the source-rebuild provenance of the previously published Godot 4.7 baseline: project.godot config/features changed from 4.6 to 4.7 in commit 840c73f but was absent from the earlier patch chain. No new engine upgrade. Apply after json-data-files.patch and before the dual-board/fields patch.

Independent party/enemy boards with versioned SELECT_TARGET_CELL policy, atomic transfer/swap, board-local targeting/spawning and actor placement; field lifecycle, movement/ZOC and deterministic preview integration. Includes all game source additions relative to ac37a9a; applies after godot-4.7-baseline.patch.

Optional scene-composed BoardCombatModule and generic card adapter preserve ordinary no-board combat, card costs and queues; board-only content fails before fees, module generations and copied request contexts preserve lifetime safety. Initial Act is configurable with side-effect-free invalid-input rejection. Fix duplicate-play logging argument. Includes all game source changes relative to 9ced42f.

Board as a removable CombatModule: core (CombatDirector, Combat, UnitSpawner, BaseAction, Signals, CardPlayAdapter, EnemyIntentController) references no board class; CombatContentRequirements refuses / greys out / skips board-only content by data markers; scene composes the module by path when present; refused boardless intents rotate instead of stalling; step-limited ValidatorPathExists, paid-cell-minimal active paths, executed path == preview, event-driven board previews, inline empty field-clock boundaries, upstream PARENT targeting restored; BoardController moved into combat/board/. Includes all game source changes relative to 2757e06; applies after optional-board-module.patch.

Per-encounter board size: CombatRulesData board_min_size 3x3 / new board_max_size 12x12 (ceiling 16x16) with limit validation; EncounterData resolves per-board sizes (encounter_boards.<id>.size > encounter_board_size > default_board_size) and rejects out-of-range sizes and off-board deploy/spawn/blocked/field/wave cells with author-facing details (CombatBattlefield.error_detail, logged by BoardController); BoardView.compute_layout, BoardCombatPresentation.view_position (board centred in its slot) and BoardActorPresentation.actor_scale_for. Includes all game source changes relative to 1f33faa; applies after board-module-decoupling.patch.

Per-combat preparation migration A: PreparedEncounter snapshots Event/Rules/Encounter once; Combat composes after preparation rather than _ready, Director consumes the same preparation and owns its active lifetime. Global separates configured and active rules, synthesis consumes prepared rules, and initial combat actions use the explicit prepared event. Preserves existing SINGLE/DUAL and board-disabled/removed behavior; does not add per-encounter zero/N board schema. Includes all game source changes relative to 2b3dec8; applies after board-size-per-encounter.patch.

Board setup/layout migration B: normalized geometry independent of legacy board mode and deployment; legacy-only faction placement policy; pure ID-to-rectangle layout and slot-aware views; explicit internal slot-free first-wave path preserves legacy positional default. Spatial rule validation no longer depends on legacy mode. No external zero/N schema. Includes all game source changes relative to 7b26416; applies after combat-preparation.patch.

layout: published game directory is a source snapshot with local patches applied; original development workspace may retain an independent upstream game checkout

engine_policy.runner: tools/test_game.py reads accepted_version_patterns for its --version probe; --accept-engine-version REGEX overrides it per run (e.g. '^4\.6\.' to replay the previous baseline).
engine_policy.rationale: Upstream Slay-The-Robot has not moved since 4dac5abe; the project tracks the current stable engine instead of the official 4.6 build it was first imported under.

Cold import on 4.7.2 did not emit 'ERROR: Unrecognized UID: "uid://bjkhgdroa1wwd".', so no import-verified re-run was needed; on 4.6 every suite's cold import emitted it and the re-run passed. The runner keeps the cold-UID rule either way.
